description: Connect to a host and read its TLS certificate: whether browsers accept it, who issued it, the names it covers, days until it expires, protocol and cipher, and the chain. Warns before an expiry takes the site down. Price: $0.01 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Site checks: Fast checks on any site without a browser: HTTP headers with a security grade and the redirect chain, TLS certificate and expiry, DNS records with mail setup (SPF, DMARC), what a site is built with and its contacts, robots.txt and AI crawler access, and a crawl that finds broken links and builds a sitemap..
